rules.statement: A purchaser of property which belongs to a third party cannot obtain a sound title if they are aware that the property does not belong to the seller, unless certain conditions are met.
rules.supporting_quote: "Property which belongs to a third party is not saleable, unless the purchaser at least was ignorant of the fact, or the parties, if they were aware, negotiated bond fide (Cens. For. 1 4, 19, 21)."
